$comment: The one place for the D-06/D-07 defaults (REQ-W1-049). Scripts, hooks, the statusline and the docs read or cite these values; a second literal elsewhere is a lint failure.

context_pct.$comment: D-18: percent of the context window; the statusline uses it whenever the percentage is known.

context_tokens.$comment: Fallback when the window size is unknown.

pre_3_12_history.$comment: D-14 / F-35: approval-format errors of an ARCHIVED change whose approval dates are all before the 3.12.0 release are warnings (recorded history, never back-filled). released_on is the 3.12.0 release date (YYYY-MM-DD), set at the release (L-35 checks it against CHANGELOG.md); null = not released yet, every archived approval so far predates it.
